title: Downhill Splits
description: Traverse a grid downward with path splits, counting routes.
writeup:
## Approach

A grid where you start at the top and move downward. `.` cells move straight down; `^` cells split the path diagonally left and right.

## Part 1

BFS from the start, following the movement rules. Count how many `^` (split) cells are encountered on any reachable path.

## Part 2

Count the total number of distinct routes from top to bottom. Use memoised recursion: at each cell, the number of routes is the sum of routes from the cells it leads to. `.` leads to one cell below; `^` leads to two diagonal cells. The `lru_cache` avoids recomputing overlapping subproblems.
